title: Two hinged bars under a load at their common joint: bar force and deflection

source.work: ANSYS, Inc., Mechanical APDL Verification Manual (public help site ansyshelp.ansys.com)
source.notes: problem statement taken from the vendor page (text; the sketch was not readable). The page cites: Timoshenko, Strength of Materials, Part I, 3rd ed. 1955, p. 10, problem 2 - NOT opened for this project; no number is taken from it. The page's 'Target' values are recorded as printed; the program's own results are not used.

analysis: Plane truss (X-Y plane, Y vertical; uz of every joint held): two equal bars of 15 ft = 180 in with hinged ends, each inclined 30 degrees to the horizontal (the page's modelling notes: half span = l cos 30, rise = l sin 30), A = 0.5 in^2, E = 30e6 psi; 5000 lb at the common joint, in the direction that puts the bars in tension (taken downward with the joint below the supports). The page prints the bar stress; the target here is the bar force = stress x 0.5 in^2. The same textbook problem is in ../staad/two-bar-truss. Reference values: computed here from this statement (verification/derive/vendor_reference.py); the textbook cited by the vendor page was not opened and no number is taken from it.
